customMarket.name: Three Portlands

state.circumstances: You've just been made general manager of Ambrose Three Portlands, the chain's main restaurant in the city, off Prometheus Plaza. Chaz Ambrose and Marius own it, along with every other Ambrose; you run this one for them, on a base fee and a share of the profit, and the rest of the chain is their business. Bettina Kowalczyk runs the kitchen. Behind it is a room of doors, and through them come the ingredients, some of the staff and a few of the guests. A year ago the Foundation's One Star Reviewers ate lunch at Temecula and shut it down. They can't follow anyone into Three Portlands, which is why head office wants this room busy and quiet.

features.name: The eye
features.pitch: It hangs over the counter and makes sure you tip.

features.name: The back room of doors
features.pitch: The same room of identical doors. The Temecula one has been nailed shut.

setting.name: Off Prometheus Plaza, Three Portlands
setting.desc: Downtown Three Portlands, on the edge of Prometheus Plaza: an anchored district of parabusinesses on permanent leases, so this building stays put while most of the city drifts slowly outward. The Plaza express trolley stops outside, and the Ways of the Docks District are a short walk away. Lunch is paratech staff, ICSUT and Deer College students and visitors from all three Portlands; dinner is Sidhe families, Maxwellists, regulars and anyone who came through a door. Menus and signs are in English and Modern Celtic.

ev.text: Derry Venimuse gave Ambrose's soda bar across town four and a half stars. Some of her readers came here for lunch afterwards.
A thread on Void about Ambrose bulldozing the city's old haunts got going again. A few regulars ate somewhere else this week.
The Omnipotent Potato Wedges got onto the prep table. Tuesday's delivery is now potato wedges.

fx.why: a delivery that became potato wedges

ev.text: Golemancy United sent a letter: the dish golem's contract covers washing up, and somebody has been asking it to peel things.
An ICSUT study group took the back half of the room for a thesis dinner and paid in sterling.
Two agents from the UIU field office had lunch, tipped properly and asked who uses the staff entrance.

world.notes:
This save is set in the universe of the SCP Wiki, behind the Veil that hides the anomalous from the ordinary world. The player runs one restaurant, Ambrose Three Portlands, for its owners. It belongs to the Ambrose chain, but only this restaurant is in the game. The other branches never appear in the player's books; they come up as head-office news, newsletters, cooks on loan, deliveries through the doors and cautionary tales.

AMBROSE RESTAURANTS (Foundation file GoI-116, threat level Yellow: non-hostile, normalcy threatening). Anomalous restaurants "in almost every extradimensional port of call", each with its own menu and gimmick; a dish is anomalous for its ingredients, its preparation or its effect. Ethos: "a remarkable culinary experience for a very reasonable price". Believed to be jointly owned by Chaz Ambrose, the founder and public face (a baseline human with minor anomalous properties, who learned thaumaturgic cooking travelling with anartists), and Marius, surname unknown, who runs the business side. Chaz writes the staff newsletter "Chaz's Corner" ("Dear Valued Ambrose Restaurant Family Members,"). Andrew is Head of Marketing; Chaz doesn't know his surname. Partners: Herman Fuller's Circus of the Disquieting (Midnight Cotton Candy, a kraken-egg caviar route) and Marshall, Carter and Dark (culinary help in return for discounts and Siberian Firebird). Behind each kitchen is a room of identical doors, each a Way to another kitchen, market or reality. The Foundation's MTF Lambda-14 ("One Star Reviewers") shuts down every branch it finds; it found the first at Temecula, California.

SISTER RESTAURANTS, as the wiki describes them. London: a four-course prix fixe, cockatrice pot stickers to a baked Alaska, 700 GBP. Backdoor SoHo: in the hidden side of SoHo in Manhattan, "the capital of anomalous counterculture", full of anartists and being gentrified by MC&D; opened 11-14 December 2014 with MC&D and the King of Hearts collective (dinner, gallery and a live act for $249) in a building haunted by its evicted former tenants. Temecula: the everyday menu this restaurant serves; now in Foundation hands. Also San Francisco; NYC (a zero-star review addressed to Chaz); A by Ambrose, disguised as a house in the Hollywood Hills; Transylvania, a hotel near Cluj-Napoca for vampires; Vienna; Gloucester; Makiling's Grove in the Philippines, hosted by the fairy queen Maria Makiling; Thorn Valley, outside New Kalmaktama in the deathless Empire of the Rose; Esterberg; Lamplight, atop the Great Spiny Mountain; Vineta; Alagadda; one for Keplerian palates; Little Havana in a nexus's tourism sector. The wiki dates Capitol Hill, DC to 2035 and Ambrose Nola to late 2025, so neither exists yet. The rest are undated; treat them as already open.

THREE PORTLANDS. An independent city-state in a pocket universe, reached by Ways from Portland, Maine, Portland, Oregon and the Isle of Portland, and in free association with the US. About 80,000 residents plus thousands of daily visitors. The ground is a shallow bowl, so the horizon curves up and the whole city is visible from anywhere. The Mayor is the city's genius loci: it supplies daylight, weather (rain copied from the Portlands outside), power and water, and the ground slowly expands, so most buildings drift towards the Periphery over the years. Prometheus Plaza downtown is anchored and doesn't drift; the Docks District beside it has the densest cluster of Ways. Spoke-and-ring streets, no private cars, free trolleys and auto-rickshaws. No local currency: dollars, sterling, and barter under geas contracts that the UIU and the Infernal Revenue Service can barely police. Golems do most labour and their union, Golemancy United, is powerful. The largest Sidhe population outside New Avalon; Modern Celtic is official alongside English. A large Maxwellist community, a paratech industry led by Anderson Robotics, ICSUT Portlands and Deer College, a famous art scene and its own social network, Void. Portlandsers distrust authority. Under the Hoover Mandate the FBI's Unusual Incidents Unit has jurisdiction over crime and the Veil, the police do outreach with security golems, and the Foundation may not act in the city at all. In April 2015 Ambrose has three establishments here and one on the way, including a soda bar in a building that used to be a much-loved bar; some locals say Ambrose is bulldozing the city's old haunts.

THE BACK ROOM IS NOT A CRIME. What Ambrose sells is legal here. The danger is what gets out through the doors onto ordinary Earth (the UIU's business) and what the Foundation and the GOC can catch outside the city. "Dirty cash" is takings in currencies no ordinary bank will take, washed by running them through the till as ordinary sales. Keep the tone light without being nonsense: this is a restaurant, and it should always be somewhere a guest would want to sit down and enjoy a nice meal. Focus on the people and the food. Staff who are cornered run for a door.

CANON AND INVENTION. From the wiki: everything above, the logo and the Temecula menu with its prices. Invented or estimated for this save: that this restaurant is separate from the soda bar, where it is and that it serves the Temecula menu; the management agreement and its terms; every member of staff except Chaz, Marius and Andrew; the UIU and GOC people; seats, rents, wages, sales and the forces' numbers; all events. The save starts in May 2015, a year after Temecula, which the wiki doesn't date. SCP Wiki content is CC BY-SA 3.0; the README credits each source page.
critics: Abigail del Toro of Marshall, Carter and Dark

forces.name: MTF Lambda-14 ("One Star Reviewers")
forces.desc: The SCP Foundation's task force for retail-oriented locations and anomalies, from single restaurants to whole shopping districts. Since Temecula it has concentrated on Ambrose, filed as GoI-116: two containment teams, fifty mobile agents, ten thaumaturgy specialists and twenty anomalous art specialists, working out of Site-34 in Southern California. The Hoover Mandate keeps it out of Three Portlands, so this is the one Ambrose it can't book a table at. Specialist Rhianne Watson, the thaumaturge who got out of Temecula alone, can follow the traces a door leaves.
forces.method: Can't act inside the city. It watches the Ways at Portland, Maine, Portland, Oregon and the Isle of Portland, follows supplies that cross Foundation ground, and traces doors from branches it has already shut back to this one. Inside the city it can only work through the UIU, and the Bureau doesn't like lending it agents.
forces.price: Not money. The Foundation's kind of offer is amnesty: keep to partitioned realities, cater its facilities, and hand over Chaz.

forces.name: The Global Occult Coalition
forces.desc: The other great power that polices the anomalous, and as keen as the Foundation to see Ambrose out of business. It built Eurtec as a rival freeport to Three Portlands, and its affiliate ICSUT has a campus by Memorial Park. Where the Foundation would put a cockatrice in a box, the Coalition would rather there were no cockatrice.

leader.name: Ingrid Solheim
leader.title: Assessment team lead (invented for this save)

forces.method: Watches the supply routes outside the city: the doors, the marina, the circus. It won't hit a kitchen inside Three Portlands, but a crate or a cook on the far side of a door is fair game.
forces.price: No interest in a deal with a restaurant. Individual assessors have been known to accept a very good dinner.

forces.name: The UIU Three Portlands Field Office
forces.desc: The FBI's Unusual Incidents Unit holds primary criminal jurisdiction in Three Portlands under the Hoover Mandate, and sole jurisdiction over the Veil. It's the biggest UIU field office in any enclave, and a quarter of its irregular agents grew up here. Ambrose's food is legal in the city. A room of doors that opens onto ordinary Earth is a Veil problem, and that's the Bureau's.

leader.name: Special Agent in Charge Ruth Okafor
leader.title: Three Portlands Field Office (invented for this save)

forces.method: Agents eat lunch, talk to the neighbours and read Void. If something from the back room turns up outside the city, they come with a Domestic Security Court warrant and want to see every door.
forces.price: Not for sale. Cooperation buys a lot: a door that's reported is a door they don't have to find.

ops.name: The room of doors
ops.cover: In Three Portlands it barely needs one: half the city has a door to somewhere. On the lease it's a delivery entrance.
ops.desc: Behind the kitchen is a room of identical doors, each a Way to another Ambrose kitchen, a market or another reality. Through them come the Soul Striders for the Seance Soup, the Circus's cotton candy and staff on loan, and through them go crates of ingredients sold on to kitchens behind the Veil and dinners for guests who can't use the trolley. They pay in whatever they have: sterling withdrawn in 1971, Hy-Brasil silver, geas-bound favours. None of it is illegal in the city. What the UIU and the Foundation care about is what might come out the other side onto ordinary Earth.
leadsTo: A thaumaturge who has learned what an Ambrose door smells like
A door that opens onto somewhere it didn't yesterday
A crate that came out in Portland, Maine instead of the kitchen

supplierPool.name: Darrel's marina

supplierPool.name: Stella Lindholm, parabotanist

supplierPool.name: The daemons of Levania
supplierPool.blurb: Cheesemakers on the Moon. The Gruyere is excellent and the delivery window depends on the phase.

supplierPool.name: Herman Fuller's Circus of the Disquieting
supplierPool.blurb: Supplies Midnight Cotton Candy to every Ambrose restaurant and runs the kraken-egg caviar route. Deliveries arrive when the circus does.

supplierPool.name: Marshall, Carter and Dark
supplierPool.blurb: The firm can find anything for a price, and sends its own clients to dinner. Partners in the Backdoor SoHo gallery.

supplierPool.name: An ordinary catering wholesaler
supplierPool.blurb: Flour, butter, oil and bacon from the ordinary world. They think Ambrose is a private members' club with an odd delivery entrance.

menu.identity: The chain's everyday menu, as the Foundation recovered it at Temecula: Seance Soup, wings that fly out of the kitchen, potato wedges that think they're better than you, a salmon arranged in a way geometry doesn't allow, and Midnight Cotton Candy from the Circus of the Disquieting.

team.name: Bettina Kowalczyk
team.bio: Ran the line at Temecula and was off the day the Foundation came for lunch. Head chef here now; cooks the same menu and keeps the wedges on their own shelf.

team.name: Eithne Dalaigh
team.bio: Sidhe, born in the city, and the only one in the kitchen who can talk to the Seance Soup's regulars in Modern Celtic. Runs the pass when Bettina is in the back room.

team.name: Cass Whitlock
team.bio: Worked the doors of half the bars in Three Portlands before Ambrose bought one of them. Knows which regulars are still angry about that, and seats them by the window.

policies.name: Medical cover for all staff, whatever they are
policies.blurb: A group plan that had to be written twice: once for people and once for the rest of the payroll.

policies.name: Family meal before every service
policies.blurb: The kitchen cooks for the staff and everyone eats together before the doors open. Nothing off the guest menu.

United States.name: United States

alcohol.note: Licensed by the state; quotas in some cities.

inspections.system: County or city health department inspections; letter grades posted in some cities.

United States.mealTimes: Lunch around noon to 1pm, dinner from about 6 to 8pm.
United States.customs: Guests expect fast, attentive service, free tap water and refills, and a check brought on request. Tipping 18-22% is expected at table service.
United States.labour: At-will employment in most states; overtime after 40 hours a week; minimum wages set by state and city.

United Kingdom.name: United Kingdom

alcohol.note: Sold under a premises licence from the local council.

inspections.system: Council environmental health officers inspect unannounced and give a Food Hygiene Rating from 0 to 5, published online.

United Kingdom.mealTimes: Lunch from about 12:30 to 2pm; dinner from 7 to 9:30pm.
United Kingdom.customs: London restaurants usually add a discretionary 12.5% service charge. Prices on the menu include VAT. Guests book well ahead for anywhere talked about, and complain quietly, in writing, afterwards.
United Kingdom.labour: Employer's National Insurance on top of pay, 28 days' paid holiday a year, a national minimum wage, and written contracts.

holidays.name: Christmas party season
holidays.note: December fills with office and family dinners.

holidays.name: Valentine's Day
holidays.note: The hardest table of the year to get.

United Kingdom.source: Entered for this save. The pound's rate is an estimate for mid-2015.

Three Portlands.name: Three Portlands

alcohol.note: The soda bar chooses to be alcohol-free.

inspections.system: The city's own. No outside government's food-safety rules reach it.

Three Portlands.mealTimes: Lunch from noon; dinner from about 6pm, with students in at all hours.
Three Portlands.customs: An independent city-state in a pocket universe, in free association with the United States since 1940. People pay in dollars or sterling and nobody needs the menu explained. The FBI's Unusual Incidents Unit keeps the Foundation out under the Hoover Mandate.
Three Portlands.labour: A small city's rules, and staff who may not have papers from any country on Earth.
Three Portlands.source: From the SCP Wiki's Three Portlands page: the pocket universe, the three Ways, about 80,000 residents, dollars and sterling, free association with the United States since 1940, and the Hoover Mandate. The payroll, card and tipping figures are invented.

Backdoor SoHo.name: Backdoor SoHo
Backdoor SoHo.mealTimes: Dinner from 7pm, and the acts go on late.
Backdoor SoHo.customs: An extradimensional city behind New York's SoHo, run on art and the people who buy it. Guests come for the gallery as much as the plate, and review everything.
Backdoor SoHo.labour: Informal. Half the floor staff are artists between shows.
Backdoor SoHo.source: The wiki names Backdoor SoHo as an extradimensional city and gives the restaurant's opening event; everything else here is invented.

profile.name: Ambrose Restaurants
profile.desc: Anomalous restaurants in almost every extradimensional port of call, from London and Backdoor SoHo to Thorn Valley and Alagadda, every one with its own menu and its own gimmick. Believed to be jointly owned by Chaz Ambrose, the founder and public face, and Marius, who runs the business side. Head office is wherever Marius is, and the restaurants are connected by the rooms of doors behind their kitchens.
profile.personality: Chaz wants every branch to be 'a safe harbour for you to enjoy the unusual delights of the universe without the horror', and to be fun. Marius wants each one to be financially sustainable, and that's the test you're held to. They're patient with a branch that's busy and quiet, and much less patient with one that draws attention, since every restaurant the Foundation finds is one they lose.

rep.name: Marius
rep.title: Co-owner, business side
rep.style: Short, broad, even-toned and unreadable. Comes through the back room without warning, reads the ledgers standing up, asks one question and leaves.

desk.title: Chaz's Corner wants a new dish
desk.text: This month's newsletter asks every branch to put one new dish on the menu 'that makes a guest gasp, then go back for more'. Chaz will write up his favourite.

choices.label: Have Bettina develop something
choices.blurb: A week of trials in the kitchen, and a chance at the newsletter.

desk.title: Another branch is short-handed
desk.text: Head office needs two of your line cooks for a fortnight at another branch, through the doors. They'll be back. Probably the same day they left, from their point of view.

effects.label: Covering for two cooks on loan

events.text: Marius came through the back room without warning, read the week's ledgers standing up, asked about the wedges and left.
Andrew's new campaign put the Ambrose sign on every car of the Plaza express trolley for a month.

desk.title: Marshall, Carter and Dark are asking around
desk.text: MC&D have been looking for Three Portlands businesses to put money into, and their people have asked to see the kitchen. Head office says it's your call whether to show them.

choices.label: Give them the tour
choices.blurb: They may send custom your way. They may also want something.
